title: Assignments
subtitleInstructor: Create graded work for your classes, connect it to a course week, and track submissions.
subtitleStudent: Your quizzes, projects and written assignments, with deadlines and feedback.

grades.title: Grades
grades.subtitle: Weighted results from graded assignments.
grades.emptyBody: Your weighted grade will appear after a teacher grades an assignment.

emptyInstructor: Create the first assignment for one of your classes.
emptyStudent: Nothing has been published for your classes yet.

peerReview.title: Peer review
peerReview.subtitle: Read a classmate's submission and leave a short score and feedback.

term.title: Term settings
term.subtitle: Set the semester start and number of teaching weeks. Assignments unlock at the start of their week.
term.name: Term name
term.hint: Example: 16 weeks starting 1 September. Week 4 unlocks three weeks after the first day.
term.noTerm: No term set; assignments are available as soon as they are published.

create.title: New assignment
create.subtitle: Publish a graded quiz, project or written assignment to one class.
create.classHint: Students in this class can receive the assignment.
create.courseHint: The assignment belongs to this course.
create.lessonHint: Optional. Connect it to the chapter learners study that week.
create.weightHint: Used for the course weighted score.
create.groupSizeHint: 1 = individual. Larger numbers auto-form groups when published.
create.peerReviewHint: 0 turns peer review off. Only individual assignments support peer review.
create.titleHint: Optional when AI generates the assignment.
create.aiPromptPlaceholder: e.g. a 5-question quiz about requirements analysis, with one short-answer question
create.fileHint: Upload a .docx, .pdf or other brief. Students can download it.
create.quizFileHint: Questions start with Q:. Options use A) B) C). Put Answer: A after each question.

detail.imageHint: PNG or JPG, up to 2 MB.
detail.publishHint: Students in this class will see it and receive an email.
detail.answerPlaceholder: Write your answer or add a note for your teacher…
detail.fileHint: Upload the final project or document (up to 2 MB).
detail.quizNote: Answer all questions. Single-choice questions are scored automatically.

actions.ownClassesOnly: You can only create assignments for your own classes.
actions.courseUnavailable: That course is not available to you.
actions.lessonMissing: That chapter does not belong to the course.
actions.weekOutOfTerm: That week is outside the class term.
actions.fileTooLarge: The file must be 2 MB or smaller.
actions.quizParseFailed: Pip could not read this DOCX. Use the Q:/A)/Answer: format.
actions.quizParseEmpty: No questions were found in the DOCX.
actions.quizQuestionsRequired: Add quiz questions before creating the assignment.
actions.locked: This assignment has not unlocked yet.
actions.answerRequired: Write an answer or attach a file.

mail.reminderBody: This assignment is due at {due}. Submit it from Assignments.
mail.gradedBody: Your assignment “{title}” was graded: {score} / {points}. Teacher feedback: {feedback}
